segments.title: Cold Open & Debate Pre-Show
segments.notes: Pepito delivers station sign-on; Case and Kendelle host pre-debate desk with Hype Train subscriber acknowledgments.

segments.title: Hype Train Subscriber Freestyle
segments.notes: Hype Train derails subscriber reads into freestyle rap over eclectic beats while Case and Kendelle react.

segments.title: Munch & Crum Debate Coverage
segments.notes: Munch and Crum join as debate analysts for the full CNN presidential debate, providing running commentary favoring Trump and Biden respectively.

segments.title: Post-Debate Desk Analysis
segments.notes: Case and Kendelle debrief the debate; Case declares Biden winner, Munch disputes via channel-point polls.

segments.title: Therapy with Dr. Hatab
segments.notes: Dr. Chath's evil cousin Dr. Hatab conducts a brief anti-therapy session, endorsing Trump and mocking Biden's coherence.

segments.title: AI President Victory Lap Calls
segments.notes: Case fields surreal call-in segments from AI Biden (alligator-surfing Moses anecdotes) and AI Trump (RoboCop Detroit patrol claims).

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Raid to Jena
segments.notes: Case closes broadcast, notes erroneous X viewership numbers, and raids Jena Darling with a presidential trap beat.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: Served as debate analyst alongside Crum, favoring Trump throughout the broadcast.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: Served as debate analyst alongside Munch, favoring Biden throughout the broadcast.

characters.notes: hype announcer. Delivered freestyle rap acknowledgments for subscribers and bits during pre-show.

characters.notes: therapist. Appeared as Dr. Chath's evil cousin for a post-debate anti-therapy session.

storylines.beat: [01:57:04] Case acknowledges chat demand for the Beyblade track, confirming the community-pledge storyline remains pending execution.

Case states he finally updated the 'flash balls' graphics package.
Dr. Hatab introduced as Dr. Chath's evil cousin.
AI Biden claims to have surfed on alligators with Moses as a child in the desert.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News aired a live watch party for the first 2024 presidential debate between Biden and Trump, with Munch and Crum providing combative analysis before Case welcomed Dr. Hatab and AI simulations of both candidates for surreal post-debate victory laps.
